headlines.headline: KNICKS LEAD CAVALIERS 1-0 IN ECF AFTER 115-104 OT WIN; GAME 2 LIVE TONIGHT AT MSG
headlines.detail: Knicks won G1 115-104 OT. Game 2 tonight 8:00 PM ET at MSG. Thunder-Spurs tied 1-1 in the West.

headlines.headline: AARON RODGERS CONFIRMS 'THIS IS IT' — FINAL NFL SEASON UNDERWAY AT STEELERS OTAs
headlines.detail: Rodgers declares 2026 his final NFL season at Pittsburgh OTAs. Harbaugh's Giants and Watson's Browns also in focus.
